displayName: C# .NET Framework / Core → .NET 10 Minimal API + EF Core 10 + xUnit
description: Reference scaffold for migrating ASP.NET MVC / Web API 2 controllers and class libraries to ASP.NET Core 10 Minimal API (Carter-style feature modules) with EF Core 10, Serilog structured logging, and OpenTelemetry traces. This is the primary target archetype for Tier-1 apps with REST surfaces: Pepperi (#3), PINpoint (#4), InfinityQS Enact (#7), Commerce Vision CVe (#5 .NET portion), and Comsense (#11). Feature-folder layout: each domain (Orders, Products, Reports) gets its own ICarterModule subclass. EF Core DbContext is Scoped. HttpClient via IHttpClientFactory. No System.Web.* references. Targets net10.0 — Linux container deployable.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the spec's target_archetype_hint is 'MinimalApi' and schemaId is 'csharp'. Primary target for former ASP.NET MVC / Web API 2 controllers.

notes: Trimmed to the files that exist on disk; the declared tests and repositories were never written. Preview until completed.
